product_one_liner.value: nudge is an employer-sponsored financial health platform that gives employees personalized financial education, action plans, timely prompts, tools and human coaching.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation link was found; employers are directed to contact a specialist for a tailored program.

eng_blog.notes: The public index contains HR/benefits insights, research, webinars and marketing content, not an engineering publication with two qualifying engineer-authored posts.

public_docs.notes: The visible navigation offers a single FAQ, not a multi-article documentation/help center; no public developer portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official board lists Strategic Account Executive and Senior Software Engineer; neither title qualifies.

model_provider.value: Microsoft Azure AI, Google AI, IBM AI Engineering
model_provider.notes: The security page explicitly names these enterprise-contracted AI APIs; it does not identify individual model versions.

compliance_certs.notes: ISO 27001 is certified; GDPR is listed as a compliance claim, not a standalone certification.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile labels the round Series A and reports $6.8 million; nudge describes the investment as a partnership with growth-equity firm Kennet Partners.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed round is March 2021, before the 2025-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Strategic Account Executive posting, remote USA; this role focuses on renewals and expansion of existing enterprise clients.

launched_6mo.notes: On 2026-09-01, nudge announced personalized financial action plans powered by numa, within the 2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On 2026-10-15, nudge announced the appointments of Debi Kesselring and Greg Goebert as Vice Presidents, U.S.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A marketing agency case study explicitly connects campaigns and leads to nudge’s HubSpot account; this demonstrates documented use, not a guarantee of the current configuration.
